verses.text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered:
"Can a person be of any use to God? Even the wise benefit only themselves.
Does the Almighty gain any pleasure from your being righteous? Does he benefit if your conduct is blameless?
Is it because you revere him that he rebukes you and brings you into court?
Isn't your wickedness great? There's no end to the wrongs you've done.
You took security from your own people for no reason and stripped people of what little clothing they had.
You gave no water to the weary and kept bread away from the hungry.
The powerful owned the land, and the privileged settled in it.
You sent widows away empty-handed and broke the strength of the fatherless.
That's why traps surround you and sudden fear overwhelms you,
why darkness leaves you unable to see and floodwaters cover you.
Isn't God in the heights of heaven? Look at the stars and see how high they are.
Yet you say, 'What does God know? Can he judge through thick darkness?
Heavy clouds cover him so he can't see. He walks above the vault of the sky.'
Will you stay on the old path that wicked people walked?
They were swept away before their time, their foundations washed away like a stream.
They said to God, 'Leave us alone! What can the Almighty do for us?'
Yet he filled their homes with good things. I want nothing to do with the schemes of wicked people.
The righteous see their downfall and rejoice, and the innocent laugh at them.
They say, 'Our enemies have been cut off, and fire has burned up what they left behind.'
Get to know God and be at peace with him. Good will come to you through that.
Please accept instruction from his mouth and keep his words in your heart.
If you return to the Almighty and put injustice far from your tents, you'll be built up again.
Lay your treasure in the dust and your gold from Ophir among the stones of the streambed.
Then the Almighty will be your treasure and your precious silver.
You'll delight in the Almighty and lift your face to God.
You'll pray to him, and he'll hear you. You'll make good on your vows.
You'll decide on something, and it will succeed for you. Light will shine on your paths.
When people are brought low, you'll ask for them to be lifted up, and God will save the humble.
He'll even rescue someone who isn't innocent. They'll be rescued through the cleanness of your hands."
